artifact: P06-02 LIMITATIONS AND OPEN ITEMS — FIRST-CLASS CONTENT, NOT OMISSIONS

classification.trackerP06_02ExitCriteria: MET — "Raw data never bypasses validation": every bypass attempt is EXECUTED at generation time and recorded as REFUSED; the governed path is the only route from raw to canonical storage
classification.recordedLimitation: L-1 — the boundary is demonstrated over SYNTHETIC LOCAL provider payloads. It has NOT been exercised against a live provider, because live provider execution remains NOT_AUTHORIZED (D9 N-1, D10 §8.2). A standing non-authorization, not a P06-02 defect.

limitations.statement: The boundary is demonstrated over SYNTHETIC LOCAL provider payloads. It has NOT been exercised against a live provider.
limitations.dischargedBy: a future explicit provider-execution authorization, which does not exist

limitations.statement: The attestation is a RE-DERIVABLE binding, NOT a cryptographic proof. There is no secret in this system. verifyAttestation re-executes the governed path from the raw payload and the declared mapping and requires byte-identity, so admission requires a raw payload and a mapping that genuinely produce the record — but a party able to run the pipeline could compute a valid attestation for a record it did produce. The property enforced is provenance-through-the-boundary, not authenticity against an adversary.
limitations.cause: no key material exists and none may be added (no credentials, D10 §8.2)
limitations.dischargedBy: not applicable within the current authority

limitations.statement: The accepted P05-04 CanonicalRecordStore is deliberately UNCHANGED. Instantiated BARE, outside the governed architecture, it still ingests any object carrying a snapshotId (BP-1). The P06-02 boundary ENCAPSULATES it in a private field and exposes no bare-record door, and auditBoundary() detects contamination. So the property delivered is prevention-by-architecture within the governed path, plus detection — not a change to the P05-04 component, which this act is not authorized to alter.
limitations.cause: P05-04 is an accepted, completed work item; its evidence must remain valid
limitations.dischargedBy: a future authority act over the P05-04 store, if one is ever taken

limitations.statement: The raw compartment is IN-MEMORY. No raw payload is persisted, so there is no raw-data-at-rest surface. A durable raw store is not claimed and would raise separate governance questions.
Three declared mappings exist (D01 quote/close/valuation), inherited from P06-01. D02–D10 are NOT declared, so the boundary is demonstrated over D01 only.
P06-02 completion is NOT P06 gate acceptance, NOT certification, NOT provider authorization and NOT production activation.
limitations.cause: D10-6 — "P06 AUTHORIZATION IS NOT P06 ACCEPTANCE."
limitations.dischargedBy: a separate explicit acceptance act by the designated A3 acceptor (Ramki)
